newsitem.title: USA: Marcus to install IMAX giant screens.
newsitem.headline: Marcus to install IMAX giant screens.

text.p: Marcus Corp said it agreed with IMAX Corp to incorporate IMAX's giant-screen system in a new cinema complex to be built in Columbus, Ohio, and at its existing 20-screen Marcus Cinemas of Addison, Ill.
The two locations are part of a multiple-theatre agreement between Marcus Theatres and IMAX.
Marcus also signed an option for three additional IMAX theatre systems.
The Addison Cinema, already the largest in the Chicago area, will grow to 21 screens with the addition of the IMAX 3D SR auditorium.

Marcus Theatres has 297 screens in Wisconsin and Illinois and 46 new screens under construction. Marcus Corp also operates and franchises 144 Budgetel Inns in 28 states; five Woodfield Suites in Wisconsin and Colorado; three hotels and a resort in Wisconsin, one hotel in Minnesota and one hotel in California; 31 KFC restaurants in Wisconsin; and one family entertainment center in Wisconsin.
